rv.q: It is a sensitive and stylish staging of a powerfully poignant play, and a welcome return for the Citz.
Poet’s script and Ross’s music manage to pitch the mood so that it’s moving but never lachrymose.
It’s wonderful to see Dominic Hill’s quietly brilliant production rise in every way to the challenges posed by the story.
There’s substance to the hope she, Ross and Hill have found in the events following the worst ever terror attack on British soil.
Overall, this new piece of theatre is a must see and a great choice to reopen the venue with after the refurb process...

cn.t: The Citizens Theatre's long-awaited reopening delivers a powerful, grief-steeped musical about Lockerbie that critics find deeply moving. Frances Poet and Ricky Ross's requiem earns widespread praise as a fitting tribute.
